exposure: history of early surgically induced abortion
Previous surgical abortion (gestational age at abortion)
history of manual removal of placenta
history of surgical abortion after 55 days of gestation
outcome: Risk of surgical intervention after early medical abortion
cohort: 86,437 women aged 15-49 years undergoing medically induced termination of pregnancy before 9 completed weeks of gestation in Denmark during 2005-2015
finding: Gestational age at termination, maternal age, previous deliveries, and history of medically and surgically induced abortions all significantly influenced the risk of surgical intervention after early medical abortion.
